A Text step label below the array is updated each pass via Transform to show the current step, minimum value, and its index. The title and subtitle are written with Write/FadeIn. The scene ends with a green 'Sorted!' label. Background is deep blue-navy (#1a1a2e). from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle


class MArraySelectionSort(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#1a1a2e"

        title = Text("Selection Sort", font_size=36, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.45)
        subtitle = Text(
            "find minimum, swap to front", font_size=20, color="#9CA3AF"
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(subtitle))

        arr = (
            MArray([5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2], style=MArrayStyle.BLUE)
            .add_indexes()
            .move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.1)
        )
        self.play(Create(arr))
        self.wait(0.3)

        values = [5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2]
        n = len(values)

        step_label = Text("step: —", font_size=22, color="#F59E0B").next_to(arr, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(FadeIn(step_label))

        for i in range(n - 1):
            min_idx = i
            for j in range(i + 1, n):
                if values[j] < values[min_idx]:
                    min_idx = j

            new_step = Text(
                f"step {i+1}: min={values[min_idx]} at [{min_idx}]",
                font_size=22, color="#F59E0B"
            ).next_to(arr, DOWN, buff=0.6)
            self.play(Transform(step_label, new_step), run_time=0.4)

            self.play(arr[min_idx].animate.highlight())
            self.wait(0.15)
            self.play(arr[min_idx].animate.unhighlight())

            if min_idx != i:
                self.play(arr.animate.swap(i, min_idx))
                values[i], values[min_idx] = values[min_idx], values[i]

        done = Text("Sorted!", font_size=28, color="#10B981").next_to(arr, DOWN, buff=0.6)
        self.play(Transform(step_label, done))
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MStack, MStackStyle, MVariable, MVariableStyle


class MStackPushPop(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f1923"

        title = Text("Stack: Push & Pop", font_size=34, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(title))

        stack = (
            MStack([], style=MStackStyle.PURPLE)
            .add_label(Text("stack", font_size=22, color="#C084FC"), LEFT, buff=0.35)
            .move_to(LEFT * 2.5 + DOWN * 0.3)
        )
        self.play(Create(stack))

        size_var = (
            MVariable(0, style=MVariableStyle.PURPLE)
            .add_label(Text("size", font_size=22, color="#C084FC"), LEFT, buff=0.3)
            .move_to(RIGHT * 3.2 + DOWN * 0.3)
        )
        self.play(Create(size_var))
        self.wait(0.3)

        ops = [
            ("push", 10), ("push", 20), ("push", 30),
            ("pop",  None),
            ("push", 40), ("push", 50),
            ("pop",  None), ("pop",  None),
        ]

        op_label = Text("", font_size=24, color="#F59E0B").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
        self.add(op_label)
        size = 0

        for op, val in ops:
            if op == "push":
                new_lbl = Text(f"push({val})", font_size=24, color="#10B981").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
                self.play(Transform(op_label, new_lbl), run_time=0.3)
                self.play(stack.animate.append(val))
                size += 1
            else:
                new_lbl = Text("pop()", font_size=24, color="#EF4444").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.1)
                self.play(Transform(op_label, new_lbl), run_time=0.3)
                self.play(stack.animate.pop())
                size -= 1

            self.play(size_var.animate.set_value(size))
            self.wait(0.1)

        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MArray, MArrayStyle, MVariable, MVariableStyle


class MVariableTracker(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0d1117"

        title = Text("Find Maximum — Variable Tracking", font_size=30, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Write(title))

        arr_vals = [3, 7, 2, 9, 4, 6]
        arr = (
            MArray(arr_vals, style=MArrayStyle.BLUE)
            .add_indexes()
            .move_to(ORIGIN + UP * 0.5)
        )
        self.play(Create(arr))

        i_var = (
            MVariable(0, style=MVariableStyle.DEFAULT)
            .add_label(Text("i", font_size=28, color=WHITE), LEFT, buff=0.25)
            .move_to(LEFT * 3.8 + DOWN * 1.5)
        )
        max_var = (
            MVariable(arr_vals[0], style=MVariableStyle.GREEN)
            .add_label(Text("max", font_size=24, color="#34D399"), LEFT, buff=0.25)
            .move_to(RIGHT * 2.5 + DOWN * 1.5)
        )

        self.play(Create(i_var), Create(max_var))
        self.wait(0.2)

        max_val = arr_vals[0]
        cur_max_label = Text(f"max = {max_val}", font_size=22, color="#34D399").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.4)
        self.play(FadeIn(cur_max_label))

        for i in range(len(arr_vals)):
            self.play(i_var.animate.set_value(i), run_time=0.4)
            self.play(arr[i].animate.highlight())

            if arr_vals[i] > max_val:
                max_val = arr_vals[i]
                self.play(max_var.animate.set_value(max_val))
                new_lbl = Text(f"max = {max_val}", font_size=22, color="#34D399").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.4)
                self.play(Transform(cur_max_label, new_lbl), run_time=0.3)

            self.play(arr[i].animate.unhighlight())

        done = Text(f"Maximum value: {max_val}", font_size=26, color="#F59E0B").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Transform(cur_max_label, done))
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MGraph, MGraphStyle, MVariable, MVariableStyle


class MGraphDijkstra(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f1923"

        title = Text("Dijkstra's Shortest Path", font_size=32, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        subtitle = Text("A → E", font_size=22, color="#F59E0B").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(subtitle))

        graph = {
            "A": [("B", 4), ("C", 2)],
            "B": [("A", 4), ("C", 1), ("D", 5)],
            "C": [("A", 2), ("B", 1), ("E", 8)],
            "D": [("B", 5), ("E", 2)],
            "E": [("C", 8), ("D", 2)],
        }
        positions = {
            "A": LEFT * 3.5,
            "B": LEFT * 1.2 + UP * 1.2,
            "C": LEFT * 1.2 + DOWN * 1.2,
            "D": RIGHT * 1.2 + UP * 1.2,
            "E": RIGHT * 3.5,
        }

        g = (
            MGraph(graph, positions, MGraphStyle.BLUE)
            .add_label(Text("G", font_size=22, color="#93C5FD"), UP, buff=0.4)
            .move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.15)
        )
        self.play(Create(g))
        self.wait(0.4)

        dist_label = Text("dist[A]=0", font_size=20, color="#34D399").to_corner(DL, buff=0.4)
        self.play(FadeIn(dist_label))

        steps = [
            ("A", None,   None,  "Visit A  dist=0"),
            ("C", "A", "C", "Relax A→C  (cost 2)"),
            ("B", "C", "B", "Relax C→B  (cost 3)"),
            ("D", "B", "D", "Relax B→D  (cost 8)"),
            ("E", "D", "E", "Relax D→E  (cost 10 → 9 via D)"),
        ]

        step_text = Text("", font_size=20, color="#F59E0B").to_corner(DR, buff=0.4)
        self.add(step_text)

        for node, from_node, to_node, msg in steps:
            new_step = Text(msg, font_size=20, color="#F59E0B").to_corner(DR, buff=0.4)
            self.play(Transform(step_text, new_step), run_time=0.4)

            g.nodes[node].set_highlight("#10B981", 8)
            self.play(Indicate(g.nodes[node], color="#10B981", scale_factor=1.2))

            if from_node and to_node:
                edge_key = (from_node, to_node)
                rev_key  = (to_node, from_node)
                if edge_key in g.edges:
                    g.edges[edge_key].set_highlight("#F59E0B", 8)
                    self.play(g.edges[edge_key].animate.set_highlight("#F59E0B", 8))
                elif rev_key in g.edges:
                    g.edges[rev_key].set_highlight("#F59E0B", 8)
                    self.play(g.edges[rev_key].animate.set_highlight("#F59E0B", 8))

            self.wait(0.3)

        final = Text("Shortest path: A→C→B→D→E  cost=9", font_size=20, color="#10B981").to_corner(DL, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Transform(dist_label, final))
        self.wait(1)

        graph = {
            "A": [("B", 2), ("D", 6)],
            "B": [("A", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 8), ("E", 5)],
            "C": [("B", 3), ("E", 7)],
            "D": [("A", 6), ("B", 8), ("E", 9)],
            "E": [("B", 5), ("C", 7), ("D", 9)],

        positions = {

            "B": LEFT * 1.2 + UP * 1.3,

        }

        g = (
            MGraph(graph, positions, MGraphStyle.GREEN)
            .add_label(Text("G", font_size=20, color="#86EFAC"), UP, buff=0.4)

        mst_edges = [

            ("B", "C", 3,  "Add B-C  weight 3"),

        total = 0
        g.nodes["A"].set_highlight("#10B981", 8)
        self.play(Indicate(g.nodes["A"], color="#10B981", scale_factor=1.2))

        for u, v, w, msg in mst_edges:
            new_step = Text(msg, font_size=20, color="#86EFAC").to_corner(DR, buff=0.4)
            self.play(Transform(step_txt, new_step), run_time=0.35)

            ekey = (u, v)
            rkey = (v, u)
            if ekey in g.edges:
                g.edges[ekey].set_highlight("#F59E0B", 10)
                self.play(g.edges[ekey].animate.set_highlight("#F59E0B", 10))
            elif rkey in g.edges:
                g.edges[rkey].set_highlight("#F59E0B", 10)
                self.play(g.edges[rkey].animate.set_highlight("#F59E0B", 10))

            total += w
            new_cost = Text(f"MST cost: {total}", font_size=22, color="#F59E0B").to_corner(DL, buff=0.4)
            self.play(Transform(cost_var, new_cost), run_time=0.4)
            self.wait(0.2)

        done = Text("MST complete  (total=16)", font_size=22, color="#10B981").to_corner(DL, buff=0.4)
        self.play(Transform(cost_var, done))
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *
from manim_dsa import MTree, MTreeStyle, MStack, MStackStyle


class MTreeBFSLevelOrder(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f1923"

        title = Text("Binary Tree BFS", font_size=32, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP, buff=0.4)
        subtitle = Text("Level-Order Traversal", font_size=20, color="#9CA3AF").next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.08)
        self.play(Write(title), FadeIn(subtitle))

        tree_adj = {
            "A": ["B", "C"],
            "B": ["D", "E"],
            "C": ["F", "G"],
            "D": [], "E": [], "F": [], "G": [],
        }

        t = (
            MTree(tree_adj, root="A", style=MTreeStyle.PURPLE)
            .add_label(Text("T", font_size=20, color="#C084FC"), UP, buff=0.4)
            .move_to(LEFT * 1.5 + DOWN * 0.3)
        )
        self.play(Create(t))
        self.wait(0.4)

        bfs_order = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G"]

        queue_label = Text("Queue:", font_size=20, color="#C084FC").move_to(RIGHT * 4.5 + UP * 1.5)
        result_label = Text("Visited: ", font_size=20, color="#F59E0B").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.45)
        self.play(FadeIn(queue_label), FadeIn(result_label))

        visited_str = ""
        queue_display = Text("[ A ]", font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(queue_label, DOWN, buff=0.2)
        self.play(FadeIn(queue_display))

        for i, node in enumerate(bfs_order):
            t.nodes[node].set_highlight("#C084FC", 10)
            self.play(Indicate(t.nodes[node], color="#C084FC", scale_factor=1.3), run_time=0.5)

            visited_str += node + " "
            new_result = Text(f"Visited: {visited_str.strip()}", font_size=20, color="#F59E0B").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.45)
            self.play(Transform(result_label, new_result), run_time=0.3)

            remaining = bfs_order[i+1:i+4]
            if remaining:
                q_str = "[ " + ", ".join(remaining) + (" ..." if len(bfs_order[i+1:]) > 3 else "") + " ]"
            else:
                q_str = "[ empty ]"
            new_queue = Text(q_str, font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(queue_label, DOWN, buff=0.2)
            self.play(Transform(queue_display, new_queue), run_time=0.3)

        done = Text(f"BFS: {visited_str.strip()}", font_size=20, color="#10B981").to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.45)
        self.play(Transform(result_label, done))
        self.wait(1)
